run_ridgesfm_pipeline: run the ridgesfm pipeline to reconstruct a 3D scene from images using ridge-based SfM and bundle adjustment
build_unet_network: build a UNet neural network for ridge feature extraction with configurable depth and feature channels
run_pairwise_ridge_sfm: run pairwise ridge-based SfM with RANSAC across image pairs to estimate camera poses
run_global_bundle_adjustment: run global bundle adjustment to optimize all camera poses and refine the 3D reconstruction
generate_scene_video: generate a video visualization of the reconstructed 3D scene with camera trajectories
